summary: Nora can find photos people sent in the same chat, by words and by how long ago, even after they have scrolled out of her recent messages.
details: media_search gains a room scope and a days look-back of 1 to 90; photos from other chats are never returned, and no sender is named.
A database error while searching her media is now reported as unavailable instead of as an empty result.
limitations: A photo older than her recent messages can be found but not yet opened or placed in a document; that resolver is unchanged.
A photo nobody has read yet cannot match words and is counted in the answer rather than listed.
